---route---
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { requireAuth } from "@/lib/auth";
import { apiHandler } from "@/lib/api-handler";
import { checkRateLimit } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { Telemetry } from "@/lib/telemetry";
import { SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, isSessionId } from "@/lib/ui-telemetry/session-cookie";
import { extractProjectId, normalizePagePath } from "@/lib/ui-telemetry/page-route";

/** Events the client capture may report. Everything else is emitted server-side. */
const CLIENT_UI_EVENTS = ["page.viewed", "tab.viewed", "section.viewed", "cta.clicked", "nav.clicked"];

const MAX_PATH_LENGTH = 512;
const MAX_PROP_KEYS = 20;
const MAX_STRING_VALUE_LENGTH = 200;

type UiEventProps = Record<string, string | number | boolean>;

/**
 * Flat object, ≤20 keys, values string(≤200 chars) | finite number | boolean.
 * The client already shapes props this way (lib/ui-telemetry/client-pure), so
 * anything else is misuse and gets a 400 rather than silently dropped keys.
 */
function isFlatProps(value: unknown): value is UiEventProps {
  if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) return false;
  const entries = Object.entries(value);
  if (entries.length > MAX_PROP_KEYS) return false;
  return entries.every(([, v]) =>
    (typeof v === "string" && v.length <= MAX_STRING_VALUE_LENGTH) ||
    (typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v)) ||
    typeof v === "boolean",
  );
}

export const POST = apiHandler(async (request: NextRequest) => {
  const session = await requireAuth();

  // Generous limit — a page view plus a handful of section/cta events per navigation
  const rl = checkRateLimit(`ui-telemetry:${session.userId}`, { limit: 300, windowSec: 600 });
  if (!rl.allowed) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Too many requests" },
      { status: 429, headers: { "Retry-After": String(Math.ceil((rl.resetAt - Date.now()) / 1000)) } }
    );
  }

  let body: unknown;
  try {
    body = await request.json();
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid JSON body" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  const { event, path, props } = (body ?? {}) as { event?: unknown; path?: unknown; props?: unknown };

  if (typeof event !== "string" || !CLIENT_UI_EVENTS.includes(event)) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `event must be one of: ${CLIENT_UI_EVENTS.join(", ")}` },
      { status: 400 },
    );
  }
  if (typeof path !== "string" || !path.startsWith("/") || path.length > MAX_PATH_LENGTH) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `path must start with "/" and be at most ${MAX_PATH_LENGTH} chars` },
      { status: 400 },
    );
  }
  if (props !== undefined && !isFlatProps(props)) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `props must be a flat object of string | number | boolean values (≤${MAX_PROP_KEYS} keys, strings ≤${MAX_STRING_VALUE_LENGTH} chars)` },
      { status: 400 },
    );
  }

  // Server-owned attribution: the client never sends these, and if it tries,
  // the server values win.
  const rawSessionId = request.cookies.get(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME)?.value;
  const sessionId = isSessionId(rawSessionId) ? rawSessionId : undefined;
  const routeTemplate = normalizePagePath(path);
  const projectId = extractProjectId(path);

  // Fire-and-forget: track() never throws, and the writer swallows sink failures.
  Telemetry.uiEvent(
    event,
    { userId: session.userId, sessionId, projectId },
    { ...props, path, routeTemplate, tier: session.tier },
  );

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
});

+import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
+import { requireAuth } from "@/lib/auth";
+import { apiHandler } from "@/lib/api-handler";
+import { checkRateLimit } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
+import { Telemetry } from "@/lib/telemetry";
+import { SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, isSessionId } from "@/lib/ui-telemetry/session-cookie";
+import { extractProjectId, normalizePagePath } from "@/lib/ui-telemetry/page-route";
+
+/** Events the client capture may report. Everything else is emitted server-side. */
+const CLIENT_UI_EVENTS = ["page.viewed", "tab.viewed", "section.viewed", "cta.clicked", "nav.clicked"];
+
+const MAX_PATH_LENGTH = 512;
+const MAX_PROP_KEYS = 20;
+const MAX_STRING_VALUE_LENGTH = 200;
+
+type UiEventProps = Record<string, string | number | boolean>;
+
+/**
+ * Flat object, ≤20 keys, values string(≤200 chars) | finite number | boolean.
+ * The client already shapes props this way (lib/ui-telemetry/client-pure), so
+ * anything else is misuse and gets a 400 rather than silently dropped keys.
+ */
+function isFlatProps(value: unknown): value is UiEventProps {
+  if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) return false;
+  const entries = Object.entries(value);
+  if (entries.length > MAX_PROP_KEYS) return false;
+  return entries.every(([, v]) =>
+    (typeof v === "string" && v.length <= MAX_STRING_VALUE_LENGTH) ||
+    (typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v)) ||
+    typeof v === "boolean",
+  );
+}
+
+export const POST = apiHandler(async (request: NextRequest) => {
+  const session = await requireAuth();
+
+  // Generous limit — a page view plus a handful of section/cta events per navigation
+  const rl = checkRateLimit(`ui-telemetry:${session.userId}`, { limit: 300, windowSec: 600 });
+  if (!rl.allowed) {
+    return NextResponse.json(
+      { error: "Too many requests" },
+      { status: 429, headers: { "Retry-After": String(Math.ceil((rl.resetAt - Date.now()) / 1000)) } }
+    );
+  }
+
+  let body: unknown;
+  try {
+    body = await request.json();
+  } catch {
+    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid JSON body" }, { status: 400 });
+  }
+  const { event, path, props } = (body ?? {}) as { event?: unknown; path?: unknown; props?: unknown };
+
+  if (typeof event !== "string" || !CLIENT_UI_EVENTS.includes(event)) {
+    return NextResponse.json(
+      { error: `event must be one of: ${CLIENT_UI_EVENTS.join(", ")}` },
+      { status: 400 },
+    );
+  }
+  if (typeof path !== "string" || !path.startsWith("/") || path.length > MAX_PATH_LENGTH) {
+    return NextResponse.json(
+      { error: `path must start with "/" and be at most ${MAX_PATH_LENGTH} chars` },
+      { status: 400 },
+    );
+  }
+  if (props !== undefined && !isFlatProps(props)) {
+    return NextResponse.json(
+      { error: `props must be a flat object of string | number | boolean values (≤${MAX_PROP_KEYS} keys, strings ≤${MAX_STRING_VALUE_LENGTH} chars)` },
+      { status: 400 },
+    );
+  }
+
+  // Server-owned attribution: the client never sends these, and if it tries,
+  // the server values win.
+  const rawSessionId = request.cookies.get(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME)?.value;
+  const sessionId = isSessionId(rawSessionId) ? rawSessionId : undefined;
+  const routeTemplate = normalizePagePath(path);
+  const projectId = extractProjectId(path);
+
+  // Fire-and-forget: track() never throws, and the writer swallows sink failures.
+  Telemetry.uiEvent(
+    event,
+    { userId: session.userId, sessionId, projectId },
+    { ...props, path, routeTemplate, tier: session.tier },
+  );
+
+  return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
+});

+"use client";
+
+/**
+ * Wraps a section of a (server) page and emits section.viewed once per page
+ * view, when ≥25% of the section or ≥200px of it has scrolled into view.
+ * A pathname change re-arms it. No-op where IntersectionObserver is missing.
+ */
+
+import { useEffect, useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
+import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
+import { isSectionReached } from "@/lib/ui-telemetry/client-pure";
+import { trackUi } from "./track";
+
+export default function SectionView({ section, children }: { section: string; children: ReactNode }) {
+  const pathname = usePathname();
+  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    const el = ref.current;
+    if (!el || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") return;
+    let sent = false;
+    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
+      (entries) => {
+        for (const entry of entries) {
+          if (sent) return;
+          if (!isSectionReached(entry.intersectionRect.height, entry.boundingClientRect.height)) continue;
+          sent = true;
+          trackUi("section.viewed", { section });
+          observer.disconnect();
+          return;
+        }
+      },
+      { threshold: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 1] },
+    );
+    observer.observe(el);
+    return () => observer.disconnect();
+  }, [pathname, section]);
+
+  return (
+    <div ref={ref} data-section={section} className="empty:hidden">
+      {children}
+    </div>
+  );
+}

/**
 * Telemetry storage plumbing: the Postgres pool and the row writer.
 *
 * Split out of `lib/telemetry.ts` purely so both files stay under the 300-line
 * cap — this is the "how it gets persisted" half; the event taxonomy and the
 * public `track()` / `Telemetry` API live in telemetry.ts.
 */
import { serverLogger } from "./logger";
import { createHardenedPool } from "./pg-pool";
import type { TelemetryEvent } from "./telemetry-types";

let _pool: import("pg").Pool | null = null;

function shouldUseSsl(connectionString: string | undefined): false | { rejectUnauthorized: false } {
  if (!connectionString) return false;
  const explicitSslMode = /[?&]sslmode=([^&]+)/i.exec(connectionString)?.[1]?.toLowerCase();
  if (explicitSslMode === "disable") return false;
  if (explicitSslMode === "require" || explicitSslMode === "prefer" || explicitSslMode === "verify-ca" || explicitSslMode === "verify-full") {
    return { rejectUnauthorized: false };
  }

  const host = (() => {
    try {
      return new URL(connectionString).hostname;
    } catch {
      return "";
    }
  })();

  if (["localhost", "127.0.0.1"].includes(host)) return false;
  return process.env.PGSSL === "false" ? false : { rejectUnauthorized: false };
}

function getPool(): import("pg").Pool {
  if (!_pool) {
    _pool = createHardenedPool("telemetry-writer", {
      ssl: shouldUseSsl(process.env.DATABASE_URL),
      max: 2, // tiny pool — telemetry is low-priority
    });
  }
  return _pool!;
}

export async function writeToDb(evt: TelemetryEvent): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const pool = getPool();
    await pool.query(
      `INSERT INTO telemetry_events
        (event_name, user_id, project_id, concept_id, session_id, duration_ms, error, level, properties)
       VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9)`,
      [
        evt.event,
        evt.userId ?? null,
        evt.projectId ?? null,
        evt.conceptId ?? null,
        evt.sessionId ?? null,
        evt.durationMs ?? null,
        evt.error ?? null,
        evt.level ?? "info",
        JSON.stringify(normalizeEvent(evt).properties ?? {}),
      ]
    );
  } catch (err) {
    // Never let telemetry crash the app — just log locally
    serverLogger.warn("telemetry write failed", {
      event: evt.event,
      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),
    });
  }
}

export function normalizeEvent(evt: TelemetryEvent): TelemetryEvent {
  const properties: Record<string, unknown> = {
    ...evt.properties,
    route: evt.route ?? evt.properties?.route,
    method: evt.method ?? evt.properties?.method,
    statusCode: evt.statusCode ?? evt.properties?.statusCode,
    requestId: evt.requestId ?? evt.properties?.requestId,
    runId: evt.runId ?? evt.properties?.runId,
    provider: evt.provider ?? evt.properties?.provider,
    model: evt.model ?? evt.properties?.model,
    signalId: evt.signalId ?? evt.properties?.signalId,
    ticketId: evt.ticketId ?? evt.properties?.ticketId,
    release: evt.release ?? evt.properties?.release ?? process.env.APP_COMMIT_SHA ?? process.env.npm_package_version,
    environment: evt.environment ?? evt.properties?.environment ?? process.env.NODE_ENV ?? "development",
  };

  Object.keys(properties).forEach((key) => {
    if (properties[key] === undefined) delete properties[key];
  });

  return {
    ...evt,
    release: typeof properties.release === "string" ? properties.release : undefined,
    environment: typeof properties.environment === "string" ? properties.environment : undefined,
    properties,
  };
}

import type { Pool } from "pg";
import { createHardenedPool } from "@/lib/pg-pool";
import type { AdminRange } from "@/lib/admin-metrics";
import {
  computePageStats,
  computeReach,
  type PageAggregateRow,
  type PageUsage,
  type PageViewRow,
  type ReachEventRow,
  type ReachRow,
} from "@/lib/admin-usage-shape";

export type { PageUsage, ReachRow };

export interface CtaRow {
  cta: string;
  clicks: number;
  users: number;
}

export interface NavRow {
  item: string;
  clicks: number;
}

export interface UsageMetrics {
  range: AdminRange;
  kpis: { pageViews: number; sessions: number; users: number };
  pages: PageUsage[];
  reach: ReachRow[];
  ctas: CtaRow[];
  nav: NavRow[];
}

let pool: Pool | null = null;

function getPool(): Pool {
  if (!pool) {
    pool = createHardenedPool("admin-usage");
  }
  return pool;
}

// admin-metrics keeps its rangeToHours private; mirror the same mapping here.
const RANGE_HOURS: Record<AdminRange, number> = {
  "24h": 24,
  "7d": 24 * 7,
  "14d": 24 * 14,
  "21d": 24 * 21,
  "30d": 24 * 30,
  "60d": 24 * 60,
};

/** Rows carry the environment that wrote them; an admin only sees its own. */
function currentEnvironment(): string {
  return process.env.NODE_ENV === "production" ? "production" : "development";
}

/** Cap on raw rows pulled for the in-process dwell / reach computations. */
const RAW_ROW_LIMIT = 50000;

const RANGE_FILTER = `created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' * $1`;
const ENV_FILTER = `COALESCE(properties->>'environment', 'production') = $2`;
const ROUTE = `COALESCE(properties->>'routeTemplate', '(unknown)')`;

interface PageAggregateSqlRow {
  /** NULL only on the ROLLUP total row (ROUTE never yields NULL). */
  route_template: string | null;
  views: string;
  users: string;
  sessions: string;
}

interface PageViewSqlRow {
  session_id: string;
  route_template: string;
  created_at: Date | string;
}

interface ReachSqlRow {
  route_template: string;
  kind: string;
  id: string | null;
  session_id: string;
}

interface ClickSqlRow {
  event_name: string;
  id: string | null;
  clicks: string;
  users: string;
}

function toNumber(value: unknown): number {
  if (typeof value === "number") return value;
  if (typeof value === "string") return Number(value);
  return 0;
}

export async function getUsageMetrics(range: AdminRange): Promise<UsageMetrics> {
  const params = [RANGE_HOURS[range], currentEnvironment()];
  const db = getPool();

  const [aggregateResult, viewResult, reachResult, clickResult] = await Promise.all([
    // Per-page views/users/sessions plus one ROLLUP total row for the KPIs
    // (distinct sessions/users across pages cannot be summed from per-page rows).
    db.query<PageAggregateSqlRow>(
      `
        SELECT
          ${ROUTE} AS route_template,
          COUNT(*) AS views,
          COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS users,
          COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions
        FROM telemetry_events
        WHERE event_name = 'ui.page.viewed'
          AND ${RANGE_FILTER}
          AND ${ENV_FILTER}
        GROUP BY ROLLUP (${ROUTE})
      `,
      params,
    ),
    db.query<PageViewSqlRow>(
      `
        SELECT session_id, ${ROUTE} AS route_template, created_at
        FROM telemetry_events
        WHERE event_name = 'ui.page.viewed'
          AND session_id IS NOT NULL
          AND ${RANGE_FILTER}
          AND ${ENV_FILTER}
        ORDER BY created_at ASC

  const wrapped = async (...args: Parameters<T>): Promise<unknown> =>
    runWithRequestContext(async () => {
      const start = Date.now();
      try {
        const result = await fn(...(args as never[]));
        record(route, 200, Date.now() - start);
        return result;
      } catch (err) {
        const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
        // requireAuth() throws these by name; map them to the same codes
        // apiHandler uses so auth failures don't masquerade as 500s.
        const status = message === "Unauthorized" ? 401 : message === "Forbidden" ? 403 : 500;
        record(route, status, Date.now() - start, status >= 500 ? message : undefined);
        throw err;
      }
    });

  return wrapped as T;
}

function record(route: string, statusCode: number, durationMs: number, error?: string): void {
  try {
    const { userId } = getRequestUser();
    if (error) {
      Telemetry.apiRequestFailed(route, ACTION_METHOD, error, durationMs, {
        routeTemplate: route,
        statusCode,
        kind: "server-action",
        userId,
      });
    } else {
      Telemetry.apiRequestCompleted(route, ACTION_METHOD, statusCode, durationMs, {
        routeTemplate: route,
        kind: "server-action",
        userId,
      });
    }
  } catch {
    // Observability must never break a mutation.
  }
}

절대 규칙

• .env, .env.local 등 env 계열 파일을 열지 않는다(cat/grep/Read 금지). DB 접속은 node --env-file=.env.local <스크립트> 형태로만 하고, 어떤 출력에도 연결 문자열·키·env 값을 찍지 않는다. 보이면 <REDACTED>.
• DB는 SELECT만. INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL 금지. 쿼리는 statement_timeout 30초를 세션에 설정하고(SET statement_timeout = 30000) 돌린다.
• 스크립트는 /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-jaeha-Projects-autokliq/0f70225c-989a-45ce-a58e-82604248d1ae/scratchpad/ 에만 만든다(예: verify-metrics-twin.mjs). pg 모듈은 저장소 node_modules의 것을 createRequire로 쓴다. 저장소에는 파일을 만들지 않는다.
• git은 읽기 명령만(git show <rev>:<path>, git diff main...feat/telemetry-enhance -- lib/admin-metrics.ts). git status나 인자 없는 git diff는 쓰지 마라(index.lock 충돌).
• 앱을 띄우거나 API를 호출하지 않는다.

배경 (확정된 사실)

• 수정 전: lib/admin-metrics.ts의 개요 성공률이 COUNT(*) FILTER (event_name='project.generate.triggered')를 분모, ...completed를 분자로 써서 30일 기준 366~377%였다. 여정 퍼널(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id))은 7일 기준 Started 3 > Generate Triggered 2로 역전됐고 이탈률이 음수였다. 지연·에러 추이는 버킷(generate_series, step 간격)과 집계(date_trunc('hour'))가 어긋나 24h 외 범위에서 전부 0이었다(30일 기준 실제 에러 74건이 0으로 표시).
• 수정 후(feat/telemetry-enhance의 lib/admin-metrics.ts): 성공률은 창 안 triggered의 DISTINCT properties->>'runId'를 분모, 그 집합에 JOIN한 completed/failed의 DISTINCT runId를 분자로. 퍼널의 queued/started/completed는 triggered runId 집합으로 제한, 이탈률 Math.max(0, …). 추이 5개 쿼리는 date_bin으로 정렬.
• 구 코드: git show main:lib/admin-metrics.ts. 신 코드: git show feat/telemetry-enhance:lib/admin-metrics.ts. 각 SQL은 template literal 안에 있고 파라미터는 $1=hours, (추이는) $2=step hours. 수정 전 파일에서 성공률 카운트 SQL은 약 :598-606, 퍼널 약 :908-918, 개요 에러/지연 추이 약 :705-758; 수정 후 파일에서는 성공률 :599-612, 퍼널 :917-928, 추이 :717-724·:747-754(개요), :1154-1161·:1181-1187(health), :1419-1426(errors). 정확한 위치는 파일에서 찾아라.

할 일

1. 두 버전에서 다음 SQL을 문자열 그대로 추출해 스크립트에 넣는다(재작성 금지; 필요한 최소한의 편집은 파라미터 바인딩뿐). 파일에서 다른 컬럼과 함께 한 SELECT에 들어 있으면 그 SELECT 전체를 그대로 쓴다.

a. 개요 성공률 카운트(triggered/completed/failed) — 구·신

b. 여정 퍼널 카운트(triggered/queued/started/completed/retried) — 구·신

c. 개요 에러 추이(errorTrend) — 구·신, 그리고 지연 추이(latencyTrend) — 구·신

d. errors 탭 severityTrend — 구·신 (있으면)

2. 같은 파라미터로 실행: a는 hours=720(30d), b는 hours=168(7d), c·d는 (hours=720, step=24)와 (hours=168, step=6) 두 세트.
3. 기준 진실(ground truth) 쿼리도 실행:
• 30일 level='error' 행 수 (c의 에러 추이 버킷 합과 비교)
• 30일 event_name='project.generate.triggered' 행 수, 그중 properties->>'runId' IS NULL 행 수
• 7일 event_name별 COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) (triggered/queued/started/completed) — 퍼널 구 값 재현용
4. 출력(값이 아닌 집계만): 표 형식으로
• 성공률: 구 (completed/triggered, %) vs 신 (%). 신 ≤ 100% 인가.
• 퍼널 7d: 단계별 구 vs 신 distinct user. 신에서 queued·started·completed ≤ triggered 인가. 신 이탈률(1 - count/prev, 클램프 적용)이 전부 ≥ 0 인가.
• 에러 추이 30d/24h-step: 구 버킷 합 vs 신 버킷 합 vs ground truth 행 수. 신 == ground truth 인가(±0). 7d/6h-step도.
• 지연 추이: 구에서 non-null 버킷 수 vs 신. 신 > 0 인가.
• health/errors 탭 추이도 같은 식으로(있으면).
5. 신 SQL이 실행 오류를 내면(문법·타입) 오류 메시지 전문(값 없이)과 어느 쿼리인지 보고. 이것이 가장 중요한 실패 신호다.

보고 형식

• 맨 위: 실행 시각(UTC), DB 접속 성공 여부, 신 SQL 실행 오류 유무.
• 위 4의 표들 + 각 항목 PASS/FAIL.
• 스크립트 경로.
• 이상 징후와 추측(표시).

function rangeToHours(range: AdminRange): number {
  switch (range) {
    case "7d":
      return 24 * 7;
    case "14d":
      return 24 * 14;
    case "21d":
      return 24 * 21;
    case "30d":
      return 24 * 30;
    case "60d":
      return 24 * 60;
    default:
      return 24;
  }
}

function stepHours(range: AdminRange): number {
  switch (range) {
    case "60d":
    case "30d":
    case "21d":
      return 24;
    case "14d":
      return 12;
    case "7d":
      return 6;

// Firebase Hosting only forwards the "__session" cookie to Cloud Run.

const COOKIE_NAME = "__session";
const USER_TIER_COOKIE_NAME = "user_tier";
const MAX_AGE_SECONDS = 60 * 60 * 24 * 30;
const LOGIN_HANDOFF_MAX_AGE_SECONDS = 60 * 5;
const LOGIN_HANDOFF_AUDIENCE = "auth-complete";

function getSessionSecret(): string {
  const secret = <REDACTED>;
  if (secret) return secret;
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "production") {
    throw new Error("SESSION_SECRET environment variable is required in production");
  }
  return "dev-session-secret-must-be-at-least-32-chars-long";
}

function getCookieDomain(): string | undefined {
  if (process.env.COOKIE_DOMAIN) {
    return process.env.COOKIE_DOMAIN;
  }
  return undefined;
}

function getSecretKey() {
  return new TextEncoder().encode(getSessionSecret());
}

function getCookieOptions() {
  return {
    name: COOKIE_NAME,
    httpOnly: true,
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production",
    sameSite: "lax" as const,
    domain: getCookieDomain(),
    path: "/",
    maxAge: MAX_AGE_SECONDS,
  };
}

export async function signSession(session: { userId: string; tier: UserTier }) {
  return await new SignJWT({ userId: session.userId, tier: session.tier })
    .setProtectedHeader({ alg: "HS256" })
    .setIssuedAt()
    .setExpirationTime(`${MAX_AGE_SECONDS}s`)
    .sign(getSecretKey());

const { Pool } = pg;

export function createHardenedPool(label: string, config: pg.PoolConfig = {}): pg.Pool {
  const pool = new Pool({
    connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
    // Neon can autosuspend; a cold wake takes a few seconds. Same sizing
    // rationale as lib/db.ts.
    connectionTimeoutMillis: 10000,
    // Close our own idle sockets before Neon reaps them server-side.
    idleTimeoutMillis: 10000,
    keepAlive: true,
    // Recycle long-lived connections so a single socket can't accumulate
    // server-side weirdness over hours of reuse.
    maxUses: 7500,
    max: 2,
    ...config,
  });

  pool.on("error", (err) => {
    serverLogger.error(
      `Database pool error [${label}]`,
      err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err)),
    );
  });

  const baseQuery = pool.query.bind(pool) as unknown as (...a: unknown[]) => Promise<unknown>;

      { error: "A variation for this concept is already being generated — wait for it to finish" },
      { status: 409 },
    );
  }
  const runId = created.id;

  // Fire pipeline to regenerate image on the SAME concept (adds to gallery)
  try {
    await dispatchPipelineJob({
      runId,
      projectId,
      userId: session.userId,
      jobType: "thumbnail_single_concept",
      conceptId: sourceConcept.id,
      improvementNote: body.improvementNote,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    // Local-dev dispatch failures (pipeline server not running) are setup noise,
    // not product failures — discard so they never pollute production metrics.
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production") {
      await discardJobRun(runId);
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Local pipeline dispatch failed" }, { status: 500 });
    }
    await failJobRun({
      runId,
      errorCode: "enqueue_failed",
      errorMessage: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      stage: "enqueue_failed",
    });
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Failed to enqueue variation" }, { status: 500 });
  }

  Telemetry.projectGenerateQueued(session.userId, projectId, {
    requestId,
    runId,
    route: `/api/projects/${projectId}/concepts/${conceptId}/variation`,
    method: request.method,
    type: "variation",
  });

  void recordConceptEngagement({

    // texts are the authenticity judge's calibration corpus (§5.3) and the
    // generate/edit routes already store theirs.

import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

/**
 * Browser session id propagation (spec C3/C4/R6, test T3): the auth helpers
 * read `ak_sid` into the request context and `track()` stamps it onto every
 * event that doesn't carry its own. Outside a request context (pipeline,
 * cron) nothing is stamped so the column stays null.
 */

const h = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  cookieJar: new Map<string, string>(),
}));

vi.mock("next/headers", () => ({
  cookies: async () => ({
    get: (name: string) => {
      const value = h.cookieJar.get(name);
      return value === undefined ? undefined : { name, value };
    },
  }),
}));

vi.mock("@/lib/telemetry-writer", async (importOriginal) => ({
  ...(await importOriginal<typeof import("@/lib/telemetry-writer")>()),
  writeToDb: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock("@/lib/logger", () => ({
  serverLogger: { error: vi.fn(), warn: vi.fn(), info: vi.fn(), debug: vi.fn() },
}));

// lib/auth pulls in the Drizzle pool + schema; neither is exercised here.
vi.mock("@/lib/db", () => ({ db: {} }));
vi.mock("@shared/schema", () => ({ users: {} }));

import { Telemetry, track } from "@/lib/telemetry";

import { getRequestUser, runWithRequestContext, setRequestUser } from "@/lib/request-context";
import { getSessionFromCookies, signSession } from "@/lib/auth-cookie";

import type { TelemetryEvent } from "@/lib/telemetry-types";

const SID_A = "3f2504e0-4f89-4d3a-9a0c-0305e82c3301";
const SID_B = "9b2e7c1a-1d2b-4c3d-8e4f-5a6b7c8d9e0f";

const lastWritten = (): TelemetryEvent => {
  const calls = vi.mocked(writeToDb).mock.calls;
  return calls[calls.length - 1][0];
};

describe("track() session id (C4)", () => {
  beforeEach(() => vi.clearAllMocks());

  it("fills sessionId from the request context when the event has none", () => {
    runWithRequestContext(() => {
      setRequestUser("u1", "free", SID_A);
      track({ event: "x" });
    });
    expect(lastWritten().sessionId).toBe(SID_A);
  });

  it("keeps an explicit sessionId over the context one", () => {
    runWithRequestContext(() => {
      setRequestUser("u1", "free", SID_A);
      track({ event: "x", sessionId: SID_B });
    });
    expect(lastWritten().sessionId).toBe(SID_B);
  });

  it("leaves sessionId unset outside a request context", () => {
    track({ event: "x" });
    expect(lastWritten().sessionId).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("uiEvent(event, ctx, props) emits ui.<event> with the ctx ids (R6)", () => {
    Telemetry.uiEvent("clicked", { userId: "u1", sessionId: SID_A, projectId: "p1" }, { a: 1 });
    const evt = lastWritten();
    expect(evt.event).toBe("ui.clicked");
    expect(evt.userId).toBe("u1");
    expect(evt.sessionId).toBe(SID_A);
    expect(evt.projectId).toBe("p1");
    expect(evt.properties).toMatchObject({ a: 1 });
  });
});

import {
  buildUiEventBody,

} from "@/lib/ui-telemetry/client-pure";
import { isSessionId } from "@/lib/ui-telemetry/session-cookie";

/**
 * T6 — pure helpers behind the client UI telemetry capture. Hooks/components
 * are deliberately untested (K2); these lock the server contract shaping and
 * the reach/viewport/admin boundaries.
 */
describe("buildUiEventBody", () => {
  it("keeps string/number/boolean props and drops objects, null, undefined", () => {
    const body = buildUiEventBody("cta.clicked", "/projects", {
      s: "x",
      n: 1,
      b: false,
      o: { nested: true },
      nil: null,
      undef: undefined,
      arr: [1],
    });
    expect(body).toEqual({ event: "cta.clicked", path: "/projects", props: { s: "x", n: 1, b: false } });
  });

  it("truncates string values to 200 chars and path to 512", () => {
    const long = "a".repeat(250);
    const longPath = "/" + "p".repeat(600);
    const body = buildUiEventBody("page.viewed", longPath, { v: long });
    expect(body.props.v).toHaveLength(200);
    expect(body.path).toHaveLength(512);
  });

  it("keeps at most 20 keys (first 20 kept, in insertion order)", () => {
    const props: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++) props[`k${i}`] = i;
    const body = buildUiEventBody("page.viewed", "/", props);
    expect(Object.keys(body.props)).toHaveLength(20);
    expect(body.props.k0).toBe(0);
    expect(body.props.k19).toBe(19);
    expect(body.props.k20).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("does not count dropped values toward the 20-key cap", () => {
    const props: Record<string, unknown> = { junk: null };
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) props[`k${i}`] = i;
    const body = buildUiEventBody("page.viewed", "/", props);
    expect(Object.keys(body.props)).toHaveLength(20);
    expect(body.props.k19).toBe(19);
  });

  it("returns empty props when none are given", () => {
    expect(buildUiEventBody("page.viewed", "/")).toEqual({ event: "page.viewed", path: "/", props: {} });
  });
});

import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

/**
 * T8 — admin metrics honesty. `project.generate.started` / `completed` fire for
 * every pipeline job type (variation, new-concept, eval scripts…) while
 * `project.generate.triggered` fires only on the generate route, so raw counts
 * put later funnel steps above earlier ones (377% success rate, negative
 * dropoff). The queries must scope those steps to runIds that were actually
 * triggered, and the dropoff math must never go below 0.
 */

// ── Mocks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type Row = Record<string, unknown>;

/** Rows returned per query, chosen by substring of the SQL text. */
let rowsFor: (sql: string) => Row[] = () => [];
const mockQuery = vi.fn((sql: string) => Promise.resolve({ rows: rowsFor(sql) }));

vi.mock("@/lib/pg-pool", () => ({
  createHardenedPool: () => ({ query: (sql: string) => mockQuery(sql) }),
}));

vi.mock("@/lib/job-sweeper", () => ({
  sweepStaleJobsSafe: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(null),
}));

vi.mock("@/lib/cloud-tasks-stats", () => ({
  getPipelineQueueDepths: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ main: null, dlq: null }),
}));

import { getJourneyMetrics, getOverviewMetrics } from "@/lib/admin-metrics";

/** Only the journey funnel query mentions the queued event. */
const FUNNEL_MARKER = "'project.generate.queued'";
/** Overview success-rate counts: the only non-timeseries query naming the failed event. */
const isSuccessRateSql = (sql: string) =>
  sql.includes("'project.generate.failed'") && !sql.includes("generate_series");

beforeEach(() => {
  mockQuery.mockClear();
  rowsFor = () => [];
});

// ── Tests ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe("getJourneyMetrics funnel", () => {
  it("clamps dropoff at 0 when a later step outnumbers the triggered step", async () => {
    rowsFor = (sql) =>
      sql.includes(FUNNEL_MARKER)
        ? [{ triggered: "2", queued: "2", started: "3", completed: "2", retried: "0" }]
        : [];

    const result = await getJourneyMetrics("7d");

    expect(result.funnel.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    for (const step of result.funnel) {
      expect(step.dropoffFromPrev === null || step.dropoffFromPrev >= 0).toBe(true);
    }
    // started (3) > queued (2) would be -0.5 unclamped.
    expect(result.funnel.find((step) => step.key === "started")?.dropoffFromPrev).toBe(0);
  });

  it("restricts queued/started/completed to runIds that were triggered in the window", async () => {
    await getJourneyMetrics("7d");

    const funnelCall = mockQuery.mock.calls.find(([sql]) => sql.includes(FUNNEL_MARKER));
    expect(funnelCall).toBeDefined();
    const sql = funnelCall?.[0] ?? "";

    expect(sql).toMatch(/runId/);
    expect(sql).toMatch(/project\.generate\.triggered/);
    for (const step of ["queued", "started", "completed"]) {
      expect(sql).toMatch(new RegExp(`'project\\.generate\\.${step}'[^\\n]*runId`));
    }
    // triggered and retried steps keep their raw per-user counts.
    expect(sql).not.toMatch(/'project\.generate\.triggered' AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND/);
    expect(sql).not.toMatch(/'project\.retried'[^\n]*runId/);
  });
});

    rowsFor = (sql) => (isSuccessRateSql(sql) ? [{ triggered: "50", completed: "40", failed: "5" }] : []);

import { getSessionFromCookies, type AuthSession } from "./auth-cookie";
import { setRequestUser } from "./request-context";

export async function getSession(): Promise<AuthSession> {
  const session = await getSessionFromCookies();
  // Attribution rides along on a decrypt that already happened — see
  // lib/request-context.ts. No-op outside a wrapped API route.
  setRequestUser(session?.userId, session?.tier, session?.sessionId);
  return (session ?? {}) as AuthSession;
}

export async function requireAuth() {
  const session = await getSessionFromCookies();
  if (!session?.userId) {
    throw new Error("Unauthorized");
  }
  setRequestUser(session.userId, session.tier, session.sessionId);
  return session;
}

export async function requireAdmin() {
  const session = await requireAuth();
  if (session.tier !== "admin") {
    throw new Error("Forbidden");
  }
  return session;
}

/**
 * API-safe auth helpers — return { session } on success or { response } on failure.
 * Use in API route handlers to get clean 401/403 JSON instead of thrown errors.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   const { session, response } = await apiAuth();
 *   if (response) return response;
 *   // session is guaranteed here
 */
export async function apiAuth(): Promise<
  { session: AuthSession; response: null } | { session: null; response: NextResponse }
> {
  const session = await getSessionFromCookies();
  setRequestUser(session?.userId, session?.tier, session?.sessionId);
  if (!session?.userId) {
    return { session: null, response: NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 }) };
  }
  return { session, response: null };
}

export async function apiAdminAuth(): Promise<
  { session: AuthSession; response: null } | { session: null; response: NextResponse }
> {
  const session = await getSessionFromCookies();
  setRequestUser(session?.userId, session?.tier, session?.sessionId);
  if (!session?.userId) {
    return { session: null, response: NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 }) };
  }
  if (session.tier !== "admin") {
    return { session: null, response: NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 }) };
  }
  return { session, response: null };
}

// Browser session id cookie contract for UI telemetry, shared by the server
// (auth helpers, /api/telemetry, pipeline) and the client bundle.
// No imports on purpose: this file must stay safe to import from anywhere.

export const SESSION_COOKIE_NAME = "ak_sid";

export const SESSION_COOKIE_MAX_AGE_SECONDS = 1800;

const UUID_V4_PATTERN = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

/** True only for a UUID v4 string (8-4-4-4-12 hex, version 4, RFC 4122 variant). */
export function isSessionId(value: unknown): value is string {
  return typeof value === "string" && UUID_V4_PATTERN.test(value);
}

import { SignJWT, jwtVerify } from "jose";
import type { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import type { UserTier } from "@shared/schema";
import { SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, isSessionId } from "@/lib/ui-telemetry/session-cookie";

export interface AuthSession {
  userId: string;
  tier: UserTier;
  sessionId?: string;
  iat?: number;
  exp?: number;
}

// Firebase Hosting only forwards the "__session" cookie to Cloud Run.
// All other cookies are stripped by Firebase's CDN layer.
const COOKIE_NAME = "__session";
const USER_TIER_COOKIE_NAME = "user_tier";
const MAX_AGE_SECONDS = 60 * 60 * 24 * 30;
const LOGIN_HANDOFF_MAX_AGE_SECONDS = 60 * 5;
const LOGIN_HANDOFF_AUDIENCE = "auth-complete";

function getSessionSecret(): string {
  const secret = <REDACTED>;
  if (secret) return secret;
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "production") {
    throw new Error("SESSION_SECRET environment variable is required in production");
  }
  return "dev-session-secret-must-be-at-least-32-chars-long";
}

function getCookieDomain(): string | undefined {
  if (process.env.COOKIE_DOMAIN) {
    return process.env.COOKIE_DOMAIN;
  }
  return undefined;
}

function getSecretKey() {
  return new TextEncoder().encode(getSessionSecret());
}

function getCookieOptions() {
  return {
    name: COOKIE_NAME,
    httpOnly: true,
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production",
    sameSite: "lax" as const,
    domain: getCookieDomain(),
    path: "/",
    maxAge: MAX_AGE_SECONDS,
  };
}

export async function signSession(session: { userId: string; tier: UserTier }) {
  return await new SignJWT({ userId: session.userId, tier: session.tier })
    .setProtectedHeader({ alg: "HS256" })
    .setIssuedAt()
    .setExpirationTime(`${MAX_AGE_SECONDS}s`)
    .sign(getSecretKey());
}

export async function signLoginHandoffToken(session: { userId: string; tier: UserTier }) {
  return await new SignJWT({ userId: session.userId, tier: session.tier, aud: LOGIN_HANDOFF_AUDIENCE })
    .setProtectedHeader({ alg: "HS256" })
    .setIssuedAt()
    .setExpirationTime(`${LOGIN_HANDOFF_MAX_AGE_SECONDS}s`)
    .sign(getSecretKey());
}

function toAuthSession(payload: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof jwtVerify>>["payload"]): AuthSession | null {
  if (typeof payload.userId !== "string" || typeof payload.tier !== "string") {
    return null;
  }

  return {
    userId: payload.userId,
    tier: payload.tier as UserTier,
    iat: payload.iat,
    exp: payload.exp,
  };
}

export async function verifySessionToken(token: string | undefined | null): Promise<AuthSession | null> {
  if (!token) return null;
  try {
    const { payload } = await jwtVerify(token, getSecretKey(), {
      algorithms: ["HS256"],
    });

    return toAuthSession(payload);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function verifyLoginHandoffToken(token: string | undefined | null): Promise<AuthSession | null> {
  if (!token) return null;
  try {
    const { payload } = await jwtVerify(token, getSecretKey(), {
      algorithms: ["HS256"],
      audience: LOGIN_HANDOFF_AUDIENCE,
    });

    return toAuthSession(payload);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function getSessionFromRequest(request: NextRequest | Request): Promise<AuthSession | null> {
  const cookieHeader = request.headers.get("cookie") || "";
  const token = <REDACTED>
    .split(/;\s*/)
    .map((part) => part.split("="))
    .find(([name]) => name === COOKIE_NAME)?.slice(1).join("=");

  return verifySessionToken(token ? decodeURIComponent(token) : null);
}

=== features/ui-telemetry/UiTelemetryRoot.tsx ===
"use client";

/**
 * Mounted once in the protected layout: emits page.viewed on every
 * usePathname() change. The ref dedupes StrictMode's double effect and the
 * same-path re-render case, and doubles as the SPA referrer for the next view.
 */

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { referrerPath } from "@/lib/ui-telemetry/client-pure";
import { trackUi } from "./track";

export default function UiTelemetryRoot() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const lastPath = useRef<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pathname || pathname === lastPath.current) return;
    // First load: fall back to a same-origin document.referrer path (if any).
    const from = lastPath.current ?? referrerPath(document.referrer, window.location.origin);
    lastPath.current = pathname;
    trackUi("page.viewed", from ? { referrerPath: from } : {});
  }, [pathname]);

  return null;
}

=== features/ui-telemetry/client.ts ===
// Browser side of UI telemetry: session cookie upkeep + the single
// fire-and-forget POST to /api/telemetry. Pure shaping lives in
// lib/ui-telemetry/client-pure (node-testable); this file owns the DOM.

import { SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, isSessionId } from "@/lib/ui-telemetry/session-cookie";
import {
  buildUiEventBody,
  isAdminPath,
  readCookie,
  sessionCookieString,
  uuidV4FromBytes,
  viewportClass,
  type UiEventProps,
} from "@/lib/ui-telemetry/client-pure";

function newSessionId(): string {
  // crypto.randomUUID only exists in secure contexts (https / localhost);
  // a LAN-IP dev origin falls back to getRandomValues-based v4.
  return crypto.randomUUID?.() ?? uuidV4FromBytes(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16)));
}

/**
 * Reads ak_sid, minting a fresh UUID v4 when missing/invalid, and always
 * rewrites the cookie so Max-Age slides another 30 minutes from now.
 */
export function ensureSessionCookie(): void {
  const existing = readCookie(document.cookie, SESSION_COOKIE_NAME);
  const id = isSessionId(existing) ? existing : newSessionId();
  document.cookie = sessionCookieString(id, location.protocol === "https:");
}

/** app/layout.tsx renders <html lang={locale}> from next-intl — read it back. */
export function getLocale(): string | undefined {
  return document.documentElement.lang || undefined;
}

/** No-op during SSR and on /admin routes; never throws, never awaits. */
export function sendUiEvent(event: string, props?: UiEventProps): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  const path = window.location.pathname;
  if (isAdminPath(path)) return;
  ensureSessionCookie();
  const body = buildUiEventBody(event, path, {
    ...props,
    locale: getLocale(),
    viewport: viewportClass(window.innerWidth),
  });
  // Fire-and-forget capture signal — must never block the UI.
  fetch("/api/telemetry", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
    keepalive: true,
  }).catch(() => {});
}

// Public entry point for client UI telemetry. Import this from client
// components; path comes from window.location, session cookie is refreshed,
// /admin routes and SSR are no-ops (see ./client).

import { sendUiEvent } from "./client";

export type ClientUiEvent = "page.viewed" | "tab.viewed" | "section.viewed" | "cta.clicked" | "nav.clicked";

export function trackUi(event: ClientUiEvent, props?: Record<string, string | number | boolean>): void {
  sendUiEvent(event, props);
}

-----action-telemetry flow-----
const ACTION_METHOD = "ACTION";

/**
 * Route label for a Server Action. The `action:` prefix keeps them clearly
 * distinguishable from real HTTP endpoints in the API traffic table while
 * still sorting together.
 */
export function actionRoute(name: string): string {
  return `action:${name}`;
}

type AnyAsyncFn = (...args: never[]) => Promise<unknown>;

export function trackAction<T extends AnyAsyncFn>(name: string, fn: T): T {
  const route = actionRoute(name);

  const wrapped = async (...args: Parameters<T>): Promise<unknown> =>
    runWithRequestContext(async () => {
      const start = Date.now();
      try {
        const result = await fn(...(args as never[]));
        record(route, 200, Date.now() - start);
        return result;
      } catch (err) {
        const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
        // requireAuth() throws these by name; map them to the same codes
        // apiHandler uses so auth failures don't masquerade as 500s.
        const status = message === "Unauthorized" ? 401 : message === "Forbidden" ? 403 : 500;
        record(route, status, Date.now() - start, status >= 500 ? message : undefined);
        throw err;
      }
    });

  return wrapped as T;
}

function record(route: string, statusCode: number, durationMs: number, error?: string): void {
  try {
    const { userId } = getRequestUser();
    if (error) {
      Telemetry.apiRequestFailed(route, ACTION_METHOD, error, durationMs, {
        routeTemplate: route,
        statusCode,
        kind: "server-action",
        userId,
      });
    } else {
      Telemetry.apiRequestCompleted(route, ACTION_METHOD, statusCode, durationMs, {
        routeTemplate: route,
        kind: "server-action",
        userId,
-----planVisualStrategyForExistingConcept-----
 * (see `reuseStoredVisualStrategy`), so what the creator picked is what they get.
 *
 * Never throws — a failed visual strategy degrades the card, it must not fail the plan.
 */
export async function planVisualStrategyForExistingConcept(
  conceptId: string,
  projectId: string,
  shared?: SharedRenderContext,
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const loaded = await loadConceptRunInputs(conceptId, projectId, shared);
    if (!loaded.ok) return { success: false, error: loaded.error };
    const { conceptNumber, selectedConcept, contentModule, psychologyFramework, techniqueSelection, context } =
      loaded.inputs;

    const { textContext: referenceImagesContext } = buildReferenceImagesPromptContext(context.referenceImages);

    const result = await runVisualStrategyLayer({
      conceptId,
      conceptNumber,
      selectedConcept,
      contentModule,
      psychologyFramework,
      techniqueSelection,
      context,
      referenceImagesContext,
    });

    if (!(result.status === 'completed' && result.output)) {
      return { success: false, error: result.error ?? 'Visual strategy produced no output' };
    }

    // Fix the on-image copy NOW, at zero image cost, so the selection card can
    // show the exact words that will be drawn — the whole point of the plan
    // stage. The render reuses this row instead of re-distilling (see
    // `planned` in resolveOnImageHeadline).
    await persistPlannedHeadline(conceptId, conceptNumber, selectedConcept, contentModule, context);
    return { success: true };
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    serverLogger.error('planVisualStrategyForExistingConcept failed', err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(msg), {
      conceptId,
      projectId,
    });
    return { success: false, error: msg };
  }
}

• 시사점(추측 표시): 스크립트 배치 제외는 바람직할 수 있으나, render-selected/new-concept/variation 같은 사용자 경로가 성공률·퍼널(started/completed)에서 빠지는 것이 의도인지 확인 필요. 대안은 이 라우트들도 triggered를 찍거나(F2가 variation에 queued를 추가한 것처럼), 개요 성공률을 job_runs(status completed/failed/stuck, source≠scripts)에서 산출하는 것.
2. 사소: 신 추이의 ::timestamp 캐스트는 세션 TimeZone 의존 — 현재 서버 GMT라 문제 없음(앱 풀도 tz 미설정이라 동일 조건). DST 지역 tz로 바뀌면 경계 시각에 bin이 1시간 어긋날 수 있음(가설, 현 환경 비해당).
3. 사소(기존 동작): 퍼널의 retried 단계는 여전히 runId 제한 없음이며 completed→retried 이탈 100%는 "재시도 없음"의 의미라 단계 순서 자체가 어색함 — F1 범위 밖.

// Cached per request — avoids redundant channel queries across layout + page
export const getActiveChannel = cache(async (userId: string) => {
  const { youtubeChannels } = await import("@shared/schema");
  const { desc: descFn } = await import("drizzle-orm");
  const [channel] = await db
    .select()
    .from(youtubeChannels)
    .where(eq(youtubeChannels.userId, userId))
    .orderBy(descFn(youtubeChannels.lastSyncAt))
    .limit(1);
  return channel ?? null;
});

/**
 * Server Action telemetry.
 *
 * Most mutations in this app are Server Actions, not API routes — they never
 * touch `apiHandler`, so until now every credit spend, channel sync, deep scan
 * and preference write was invisible to the admin dashboards. This mirrors what
 * `apiHandler` does for routes: one `api.request.*` event per invocation, with
 * a synthetic `action:<name>` route so both surfaces aggregate side by side.
 *
 * Usage — wrap the implementation, keep the export an async function:
 *
 *   export const addKeyword = trackAction(
 *     "inspirations.addKeyword",
 *     async (channelId: string, keyword: string) => { ... },
 *   );
 *
 * Like `apiHandler`, telemetry here can never fail the action: the recording
 * call is try/caught and the original result or error always propagates.
 */
import { Telemetry } from "@/lib/telemetry";
import { getRequestUser, runWithRequestContext } from "@/lib/request-context";

/** Server Actions have no HTTP verb; this keeps the dashboards' method column
 *  meaningful instead of blank. */
const ACTION_METHOD = "ACTION";

/**
 * Route label for a Server Action. The `action:` prefix keeps them clearly
 * distinguishable from real HTTP endpoints in the API traffic table while
 * still sorting together.
 */
export function actionRoute(name: string): string {
  return `action:${name}`;
}

type AnyAsyncFn = (...args: never[]) => Promise<unknown>;

export function trackAction<T extends AnyAsyncFn>(name: string, fn: T): T {
  const route = actionRoute(name);

결함 목록 (심각도순)

1. 중간 · SectionView.tsx:33 — threshold [0,.25,.5,1]이라 콜백이 ratio 0→0.25 사이에서 발화하지 않음. 높이 >800px 섹션(예: channel.videos-recent, intelligence.market)을 천천히 스크롤하면 200px가 아니라 25%(2000px 섹션이면 500px) 노출 시점에야 기록 → I8 "≥200px" 규칙 미적용. 수정: observe 전에 const h = el.getBoundingClientRect().height; threshold: [0, Math.min(0.25, h > 0 ? 200 / h : 0.25), 0.25, 0.5, 1] 또는 0.05 간격 배열.
2. 낮음 · auth-cookie.ts:176 — ak_sid 삭제 쿠키에 domain: getCookieDomain() 지정, 클라이언트는 Domain 없이(host-only) 설정. COOKIE_DOMAIN 설정 시 브라우저가 다른 쿠키로 취급해 삭제 실패. 현재 cloudbuild.yaml에 COOKIE_DOMAIN 없음 → 지금은 동작. 수정: ak_sid 삭제엔 domain 생략.
3. 낮음 · admin-usage.ts:60,134,151 — views(ORDER BY created_at ASC)·reach(무순서) LIMIT 50000 캡 vs aggregates는 전체 집계 → 캡 초과 시 최신 뷰 탈락(dwell) / sessionsReached 과소(reachRate 편향). 60d 창에서 25섹션×2000세션이면 도달. 수정: dwell은 SQL LEAD() 윈도우, reach는 COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) GROUP BY로 SQL 집계 후 순수 함수는 비율만 계산 — 또는 캡 초과 시 UI에 truncated 표시.
4. 낮음 · client.ts:38-54 — sendUiEvent가 CTA 핸들러 첫 줄에서 동기 호출되는데 try/catch 없음. document.cookie/crypto 접근이 던지는 환경(샌드박스 iframe, 쿠키 차단 브라우저)에서 generate/subscribe 핸들러 자체가 중단. 수정: 본문 전체 try/catch.
5. 낮음 · ConceptSelectionSection.tsx:55 — trackUi가 selectedIds.length===0 || busy guard 앞이라 no-op 클릭도 집계(버튼 disabled라 실질 영향 미미). guard 뒤로 옮겨도 I11(fetch 전) 충족.
6. 낮음 · route.ts:85 — 클라이언트가 props에 userId/sessionId/projectId 키를 실으면 컬럼은 서버값이지만 properties JSON에 잔존. 쿼리가 컬럼만 쓰므로 무해; 원하면 spread 후 해당 키 delete.

(StrictMode 이중 전송, IO 미지원, 서버 컴포넌트 children, 파이프라인에서 getRequestUser 안전성, 이메일 등 PII props 삽입, 시크릿 — 모두 문제 없음 확인.)

테스트 신뢰성 (T1~T10)

• T1: 실제 라우트 실행, auth/rate-limit/telemetry만 모킹 → 검증·보강 로직은 진짜. 429는 checkRateLimit 모킹(계획 B 명시; 키·옵션 단언). "ui." 접두어는 T3가 검증. 신뢰 가능.
• T2: 순수 함수 실 실행, 스펙 4케이스 + 쿼리 제거. 신뢰 가능.
• T3: 실제 getSessionFromCookies/apiAuth/track, next/headers·writeToDb만 모킹. 컨텍스트 채움/명시 우선/컨텍스트 밖 null/UUID 검증/DEV 바이패스 전부 단언. 신뢰 가능.
• T4: 실제 normalizeEvent/writeToDb, pool만 모킹. 삼킴 + session_id 파라미터 위치 단언. 신뢰 가능.
• T5: generateImagesForExistingConcept→completeConceptLayersNew→runVisualStrategyLayer 실경로 확인(LLM/이미지/DB/판정만 모킹). PROJECT_ID≠CONCEPT_ID이고 main 코드(conceptId 전달)면 실패하는 진짜 회귀 테스트, 5곳을 성공·실패 2케이스로 커버. 신뢰 가능(V1 요구 충족).
• T6: 순수 함수, 경계값(24/25, 199/200, 767/768, 0높이) 포함. 신뢰 가능.
• T7: 세션 마지막 뷰 제외·세션 간 미결합·시간 정렬·짝수 중앙값·null 정렬 단언. 신뢰 가능.
• T8: pool 모킹이라 SQL의 runId 제한은 구조상 실행 검증 불가 — SQL 텍스트 정규식 + 클램프 실행 단언. 스펙 요구(모킹으로 dropoff≥0)는 충족하나 SQL 정합성은 V7에 의존.
• T9: 실제 라우트, plan_only/full 두 모드에서 triggered·queued 모두 type 단언. 신뢰 가능.
• T10: 실제 라우트, queued 1회 + type/runId + triggered 미호출 단언. 신뢰 가능.

상태

• 브라우저 도구 동작 불가 — navigate 직후 탭이 chrome://newtab으로 되돌아가고(3회 재현), 이후 확장이 "not connected"로 응답. 브라우저 단계는 건너뛰었고 리드가 직접 돌려야 합니다.
• 시작 06:11:16Z / 종료 06:36:48Z. curl 프로브 창 06:27:44Z–06:35:17Z.
• dev 서버가 옆 worktree autokliq-tel-B의 next build와 브랜치 이동(HMR) 겹침으로 약 6분간 무응답이었다가 스스로 회복(재시작 안 함).

핵심 결과

• **이 DB에는 ui.* 행이 역사상 0건**(제 프로브 3건 제외) — 실제 브라우저 클라이언트가 이벤트를 보낸 기록이 아직 없음.
• 서버 절반(curl 프로브) PASS: routeTemplate 정규화(쿼리 제거 포함), /projects/[id]의 project_id 채움, ak_sid→session_id 정확 일치, 비UUID ak_sid 무시, tier 서버 강제, environment=development, 401/400 검증 전부 기대대로.
• FAIL 1건: 같은 ak_sid로 /intelligence를 열었을 때 action:inspirations.getInspirations 행의 session_id·user_id가 NULL. 원인(코드 확인): trackAction은 컨텍스트 안에서 requireAuth()/getSession()이 호출돼야 attribution이 채워지는데, 읽기 전용 액션 9개(getInspirations, getAudienceTruthLayers, getAnalysisStatus, getDeepScanStatus, getRecommendations, getProjectConcepts, getHypotheses, getPreferences, setUiLocale)는 인증 호출이 없음. API 라우트(/api/auth/me)는 정상 전파.
• 설계상 공백: 세션 최초 문서 요청은 ak_sid가 아직 없어 그 렌더 중 서버 이벤트는 항상 NULL.
• 클라이언트 캡처(섹션 25개, 탭, CTA, nav)는 미검증.

제안(수정 안 함)

trackAction 래퍼에서 getSession()을 선호출해 구조적으로 채우기, middleware에서 ak_sid 서버 발급 검토, /api/telemetry 서버측 admin 가드, usage 탭의 NULL-session 뷰 집계 각주.

스크래치패드에 SELECT 전용 스크립트(verify-ui-events.mjs --since <ISO>)를 남겼으니 리드가 브라우저 흐름을 돌린 뒤 그대로 실행하면 표 1의 나머지 항목이 채워집니다. 프로브 행은 properties->>'probe' IS NOT NULL로 제외 가능합니다.

외부 리뷰에서 나온 결함 2건을 같은 worktree(~/Projects/autokliq-tel-C), 같은 브랜치 HEAD(dd7f124) 위에 커밋 하나로 고쳐라. 브랜치 병합·push 금지, 소유 파일 외 수정 금지.

1. (중간) features/ui-telemetry/SectionView.tsx — IntersectionObserver threshold가 [0, .25, .5, 1]이라 콜백이 ratio 0~25% 사이에서 발화하지 않아 큰 섹션(800px 초과)에서 "교차 높이 ≥ 200px" 규칙이 사실상 평가되지 않는다. 수정: observe 직전에 요소 높이 h = el.getBoundingClientRect().height 를 재고, threshold를 0부터 1까지 0.05 간격 배열(21개)에 h > 0이면 Math.min(1, 200 / h)를 추가한 배열(중복 제거, 오름차순)로 만든다. 판정 함수 isSectionReached(client-pure.ts)는 그대로 둔다(T6 무변경).
2. (낮음) features/ui-telemetry/client.ts — sendUiEvent는 CTA 핸들러 첫 줄에서 동기 호출되는데 try/catch가 없어 document.cookie/crypto 접근이 던지는 환경(샌드박스 iframe, 쿠키 차단)에서 핸들러 자체가 중단된다. 수정: sendUiEvent 본문 전체를 try { ... } catch { /* telemetry must never block the UI */ } 로 감싼다(fetch의 .catch는 유지). ensureSessionCookie 내부도 같은 원칙.

게이트 순차: npm run check, npm run lint, npm run test:run.

커밋:

[features][ui-telemetry] fix: section reach thresholds and never-throw client send

• SectionView: 0.05 간격 threshold + 200px/높이 지점 추가 → 큰 섹션에서도 200px 규칙 평가
• client.ts: sendUiEvent/ensureSessionCookie를 try/catch로 감싸 CTA 핸들러를 절대 막지 않음

문제(실측·코드 확인됨): lib/action-telemetry.ts의 trackAction은 runWithRequestContext로 감싼 뒤 record()에서 getRequestUser()를 읽는데, 액션 본문이 requireAuth()/getSession()을 호출할 때만 setRequestUser가 실행된다. 인증 호출 없이 DB만 읽는 액션 9개(inspirations.getInspirations, getDeepScanStatus, getRecommendations / audience-truth.getAudienceTruthLayers, getAnalysisStatus / projects.getProjectConcepts / learnings.getHypotheses, getPreferences / locale.setUiLocale)는 action:* 행의 user_id·session_id가 NULL로 남는다.

수정(구조적): lib/action-telemetry.ts의 trackAction에서 액션 본문 fn(...args) 실행 직전에 await getSession()을 호출한다(import { getSession } from "@/lib/auth"). getSession()은 세션이 없으면 null을 돌려주고 throw하지 않으며, 있으면 setRequestUser(userId, tier, sessionId)를 스스로 호출한다. 액션 본문이 나중에 requireAuth()를 다시 불러도 무해하다. 이 파일은 파이프라인 서버에서 절대 실행되지 않으므로(호출자는 actions/*뿐) next/headers가 lib/auth 경유로 모듈 그래프에 들어와도 런타임 위험이 없고, 타입체크는 이미 lib/auth.ts가 같은 조건에서 통과하고 있다. 스펙 C3의 "next/headers를 action-telemetry.ts에 추가하지 않는다" 문구는 이 구조적 수정을 위해 리드가 완화했다. lib/telemetry.ts에는 여전히 추가하지 않는다. actions/*.ts 파일은 수정하지 않는다.

테스트: lib/__tests__/telemetry-session.test.ts에 케이스 1개 추가 — next/headers cookies()를 스텁해 유효 __session + ak_sid를 제공하고, requireAuth를 호출하지 않는 더미 액션을 trackAction("x", fn)으로 감싸 실행 → Telemetry.apiRequestCompleted(또는 record가 호출하는 실제 헬퍼)가 받은 이벤트/props에 userId와 sessionId가 채워져 있음을 단언. 기존 T3 케이스의 next/headers 스텁 방식을 재사용한다. @/lib/telemetry는 필요한 헬퍼만 스텁.

/opt/homebrew/bin/dev-browser
Dev Browser is a CLI for controlling local or external browsers with JavaScript scripts.
Scripts run in a sandboxed QuickJS runtime (not Node.js). Top-level `await` is
available, along with a preconnected `browser` global and standard `console` output.
A background daemon starts automatically when needed and manages browser instances,
named pages, and CDP connections.

SANDBOX ENVIRONMENT:
  Scripts execute inside a QuickJS WASM sandbox with no arbitrary access to the host system.
  This is NOT Node.js — the following are NOT available:
    - require() / import()     No module loading
    - process                  No process access
    - fs / path / os           No direct filesystem access
    - fetch / WebSocket        No direct network access
    - __dirname / __filename   No path globals

  Available globals:
    browser                    Pre-connected browser handle (see API below)
    console                    log, warn, error, info (routed to CLI output)
    setTimeout / clearTimeout  Basic timers
    saveScreenshot(buf, name)  Save a screenshot buffer (async, must be awaited)
    writeFile(name, data)      Write a file to temp dir (async, must be awaited)
    readFile(name)             Read a file from temp dir (async, must be awaited)

  Memory and CPU limits are enforced. Infinite loops will be interrupted.

Primary invocation styles:
  dev-browser <<'EOF'
    const page = await browser.getPage("main");
    await page.goto("https://example.com");
    console.log(await page.title());
  EOF

  dev-browser run script.js
  dev-browser --browser my-project < script.js
  dev-browser --connect http://localhost:9222 <<'EOF'
    const page = await browser.getPage("main");
    await page.goto("https://example.com");
  EOF
  dev-browser --connect <<'EOF'
    const page = await browser.getPage("main");

Script API available inside every script:
  browser.getPage(nameOrId) Get a page by name (creates if new) or connect to an existing
                            tab by its targetId from listPages().
  browser.newPage()       Create an anonymous page. Anonymous pages are cleaned up after the script exits.
  browser.listPages()       List all tabs: named pages and existing browser tabs.
                            Returns [{id, url, title, name}].
  browser.closePage(name) Close and remove a named page.
  await saveScreenshot(buf: Buffer, name: string): Promise<string>
                          Save a screenshot buffer to ~/.dev-browser/tmp/<name>.
                          Returns the full path to the saved file.
                          Example: const path = await saveScreenshot(await page.screenshot(), "home.png");

  await writeFile(name: string, data: string): Promise<string>
                          Write data to ~/.dev-browser/tmp/<name>.
                          Returns the full path to the written file.
                          Example: const path = await writeFile("results.json", JSON.stringify(data));

  await readFile(name: string): Promise<string>
                          Read a file from ~/.dev-browser/tmp/<name>.
                          Returns the file content as a string.
                          Example: const data = JSON.parse(await readFile("results.json"));

  console.log/info(...)   Write output to stdout.
  console.warn/error(...) Write output to stderr.

  All file I/O functions are async and must be awaited.
  All paths are restricted to ~/.dev-browser/tmp/ — no filesystem escape.

Pages returned by `browser.getPage()` and `browser.newPage()` are full Playwright
Page objects — you get the same API (goto, click, fill, locator, evaluate, etc.):
  https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-page

threshold 배열 생성 (features/ui-telemetry/SectionView.tsx:25-28, observe 직전):


const height = el.getBoundingClientRect().height;
const steps = Array.from({ length: 21 }, (_, i) => i / 20);
if (height > 0) steps.push(Math.min(1, 200 / height));
const threshold = Array.from(new Set(steps)).sort((a, b) => a - b);
// …
new IntersectionObserver(cb, { threshold })
• i / 20으로 0, 0.05, …, 1 (21개, i*0.05의 부동소수 잔재 없음). height ≤ 200이면 200/h ≥ 1 → min으로 1 → Set이 중복 제거하므로 21개 그대로; height > 200이면 22개(또는 0.05 배수와 정확히 같으면 21개).
• 판정은 여전히 isSectionReached(intersectionRect.height, boundingClientRect.height) — 변경 없음.

client.ts: ensureSessionCookie 본문과 sendUiEvent 본문 전체를 각각 try { … } catch { /* telemetry must never block the UI */ }로 감쌈. fetch의 .catch(() => {}) 유지. getLocale은 sendUiEvent try 안에서만 호출되므로 별도 래핑 안 함.

남은 우려 (추측): height는 effect 시점 1회 측정이라 이미지 지연 로드 등으로 섹션이 나중에 커지면 200px 지점 threshold가 실제 높이와 어긋날 수 있음 — 그래도 0.05 간격 스텝이 있어 최대 5% 높이 지연 후 평가됨. 또한 threshold 경계에서 intersectionRect.height가 199.99…로 나올 수 있는 부동소수 케이스는 다음 0.05 스텝에서 잡힘.

2. 성공률 분모 범위에 대한 결정. 지금 정의는 generate 라우트로 시작한 배치만 셉니다. render-selected, new-concept, variation 같은 사용자 경로와 스크립트 배치는 분모 밖이라, 실패가 그쪽에서만 나면 100%로 보입니다. 선택지는 a) 이번 루프는 스펙대로 두고 다음 루프에서 queued runId 기준으로 넓힌다 추천, b) 지금 넓힌다(스펙 M1·M2 개정 후 F1 재작업).

승인(V6)은 브라우저 검증까지 끝난 뒤 PR과 함께 요청하겠습니다.

DNS 원인을 찾았습니다. 공유기(192.168.1.254)와 공개 DNS 모두 응답은 하지만, macOS 시스템 리졸버가 "no nameserver" 상태라 앱들이 이름을 못 풉니다. 절전 후 리졸버 캐시가 꼬인 전형적 증상입니다. 시스템 설정은 제가 건드리지 않으므로 아래 명령을 직접 실행해 주세요.


! sudo dscacheutil -flushcache; sudo killall -HUP mDNSResponder

이걸로 안 되면 Wi-Fi를 껐다 켜 주세요. 복구되면 이어서 build, dev 서버 재시작, Playwright 설치, 브라우저 검증, DB 대조를 순서대로 돌립니다.

그동안 네트워크 없이 할 수 있는 일은 없습니다. 코드와 문서는 전부 커밋돼 있고(6953ec8), 이전 메시지의 결정 요청 2번(성공률 분모 범위)은 아직 답이 필요합니다. 추천은 a) 이번 루프는 스펙대로 두고 다음 루프에서 queued runId 기준으로 넓히기입니다.

너는 검증자다. 코드를 작성한 에이전트가 아니며 저장소 파일을 수정하지 않는다. 목적: 브랜치 feat/telemetry-enhance의 브라우저 UI telemetry가 스펙대로 DB에 도착하는지 외부에서 대조한다(5-b의 V2·V3·V4).

환경

• 검증용 dev 서버: http://localhost:3100 (worktree ~/Projects/autokliq-tel-D1, 최종 커밋 6953ec8, NODE_ENV=development). 포트 3000은 사용자 서버이니 건드리지 않는다. 서버를 재시작하거나 죽이지 않는다. 첫 페이지 컴파일에 10~30초 걸릴 수 있으니 타임아웃은 넉넉히.
• 브라우저: dev-browser CLI(Playwright Chromium 설치 완료). 사용법: dev-browser --headless --timeout 120 <<'EOF' … EOF — 스크립트 안에서 const page = await browser.getPage("v2"); 로 이름 붙인 페이지를 얻으면 스크립트 실행 간에 상태(쿠키·탭)가 유지된다. page는 Playwright Page API 전체(goto, click, locator, evaluate, screenshot, waitForLoadState 등). await saveScreenshot(await page.screenshot({fullPage:true}), "name.png") 로 ~/.dev-browser/tmp/name.png 저장. 샌드박스라 require/fetch/fs 없음. 작은 스크립트를 여러 번 실행하고 매번 console.log로 상태를 남겨라.
• DB 읽기: 저장소 ~/Projects/autokliq 에서 node --env-file=.env.local <스크립트> 로만. pg는 createRequire("~/Projects/autokliq/package.json")("pg"). SELECT만. 스크립트는 /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-jaeha-Projects-autokliq/0f70225c-989a-45ce-a58e-82604248d1ae/scratchpad/ 에 둔다.

절대 규칙

• .env 계열 파일을 열지 않는다(cat/grep/Read 금지). 출력에 연결 문자열·키·쿠키 값 전체를 찍지 않는다(세션 UUID는 찍어도 됨).
• 크레딧을 쓰는 버튼(생성, 새 컨셉, 변형, 선택 렌더, 딥스캔, 오디언스 분석, 결제/구독)은 절대 누르지 않는다. 눌러도 되는 CTA는 채널 페이지의 동기화(Sync) 버튼 1회뿐.
• 저장소 파일 수정·생성 금지. git은 읽기 명령만.

구현된 계약 (대조 기준)

• 클라이언트가 POST /api/telemetry 로 보내고 서버가 telemetry_events에 event_name "ui.<event>"로 저장. 컬럼: event_name, user_id, project_id, session_id, created_at, properties(JSONB).
• 세션 쿠키 ak_sid(UUID v4)를 클라이언트가 만들고, 서버는 requireAuth/getSession 경로와 trackAction에서 읽어 웹 서버 이벤트(api.request.*, action:*)에도 같은 session_id를 붙인다. 파이프라인 이벤트는 대상 아님.
• 이벤트/properties: ui.page.viewed(routeTemplate, path, referrerPath?, locale, viewport, tier) / ui.tab.viewed(routeTemplate, tab, trigger "default"|"click") / ui.section.viewed(routeTemplate, section) / ui.cta.clicked(routeTemplate, cta) / ui.nav.clicked(routeTemplate, item, from). properties.environment="development".
• /projects/[id] 행은 project_id 채워짐. /admin 경로는 이벤트 없음.
• 섹션 식별자 25개: intelligence.{next-action,strategy-hero,stats,lineage,performance,identity,personas,patterns,market,recent-projects}, project.{brief,content-analysis,generation-panel,concept-selection,concept-grid,packaging}, channel.{overview-stats,recent-analytics,videos-recent,videos-top,brand-kit,brand-dna,comments,danger-zone}, inspirations.trending-now. 조건부 섹션은 데이터가 없으면 렌더되지 않는다(미렌더로 분류, 실패 아님 — 단 화면 근거를 적어라). 도달 판정은 요소가 뷰포트와 교차하고 교차 높이가 요소 높이의 25% 이상 또는 200px 이상일 때 1회.
• 탭: audience-truth 6개(truth, comments, drives, who, click, truths), inspirations 4개(recommendations, trends, competitors, techniques). 페이지 첫 진입에 trigger "default" 1건, 클릭마다 "click" 1건(같은 탭 연속은 중복 안 됨).
• 사이드바 메뉴 클릭 → ui.nav.clicked(item = newThumbnail|channels|intelligence|audienceTruth|inspirations|learnings|skills|projects|assets|account).
• admin usage 탭: /admin?tab=usage — environment=development 행만 집계해 페이지별 뷰/세션/유저/체류 중앙값, 섹션·탭 도달률(오름차순), CTA·내비 클릭을 보여준다.

절차

0. 시작 시각 UTC를 기록(DB 조회 창 시작). date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ.
1. 브라우저 흐름 (페이지마다 waitForLoadState("networkidle") 후, 끝까지 3~4단계로 나눠 스크롤하며 각 단계 400ms 대기, 마지막에 fullPage 스크린샷 저장):

a. goto http://localhost:3100/api/dev?action=auto-login&userId=80b99389-f8a6-4db3-81da-3dc9d6c735aa&redirect=/intelligence → /intelligence 도착 확인 → 끝까지 스크롤

b. 사이드바에서 "프로젝트" 메뉴 클릭(href="/projects"인 사이드바 링크; nav 1회) → 첫 프로젝트 카드 클릭 → /projects/<id> 끝까지 스크롤 (프로젝트가 없으면 보고하고 건너뜀)

c. 사이드바 "채널" 클릭(href="/channels"; nav 2회) → /channels/<id>로 리다이렉트 → 끝까지 스크롤 → 동기화(Sync) 버튼 1회 클릭(CTA) → 3초 대기

d. goto /audience-truth → 6개 탭 버튼을 순서대로 전부 클릭(각 클릭 후 500ms)

e. goto /inspirations → 4개 탭 버튼 순서대로 전부 클릭

f. 어느 한 페이지에서 page.on("response")로 /api/telemetry 응답 상태를 모아 200인지 확인(스크립트 하나로 goto 전에 리스너 등록)

g. goto /admin?tab=usage → 5초 대기 → fullPage 스크린샷 + page.locator("main").innerText()로 표 텍스트 확보

h. goto /admin?tab=overview&range=30d 와 /admin?tab=journey 도 스크린샷 1장씩(수정 후 지표 확인용) — 이 두 페이지는 이벤트를 안 만든다.

요소 선택은 텍스트(한국어 UI: 프로젝트/채널/동기화 등)나 href, data-section 속성으로 찾고, 못 찾으면 page.content()를 일부 출력해 구조를 보고 다시 시도. 실패한 단계는 건너뛰고 보고에 적는다.

2. 종료 시각 기록.
3. DB 대조 스크립트(SELECT만). 창: 시작 시각 이후, user_id='80b99389-f8a6-4db3-81da-3dc9d6c735aa', COALESCE(properties->>'environment','production')='development', properties->>'probe' IS NULL. 출력(집계만):
• ui.* event_name별 COUNT
• ui.page.viewed의 routeTemplate 집합과 건수
• ui.section.viewed의 section 집합 → 25개와 대조(도착/미도착/미렌더)
• ui.tab.viewed의 (routeTemplate, tab, trigger) 목록
• ui.cta.clicked의 cta 목록(channel-sync 1 기대), ui.nav.clicked의 item 목록(projects, channels 기대)
• ui.* 행의 DISTINCT session_id 수(1 기대)와 NULL 수(0 기대)
• 같은 창·같은 user의 api.request.* 및 action:* 행(event_name LIKE 'api.request.%' 또는 properties->>'route' LIKE 'action:%'): session_id가 ui.*와 같은 값인 비율, NULL 수, NULL인 행의 route 목록 상위 5개(첫 문서 요청·인증 전 라우트는 예외로 표기)
• routeTemplate='/projects/[id]' 행의 project_id NOT NULL 수 / 전체
• path LIKE '/admin%' 인 ui.* 행 수(0 기대)
• event_name별 properties 키 목록 1행씩(값 말고 키)
4. usage 탭 텍스트의 수치(페이지뷰·세션·유저 KPI, 페이지 표, 도달률 표)와 3의 집계를 대조(같은 창·같은 필터가 아니므로 usage 탭은 24h/7d 기본창 — 차이가 나면 이유를 적는다).

보고 형식

• 맨 위: 브라우저 흐름 성공 여부, 시작·종료 시각(UTC), 건너뛴 단계.
• 표 1 기대 vs 실제(page.viewed 라우트 / 섹션 25개 / 탭 / cta / nav / session_id 단일성 / 서버 이벤트 session_id 일치 / project_id / admin 0건 / /api/telemetry 응답 코드), 각 PASS/FAIL/미렌더(근거).
• 표 2 usage 탭 수치 vs DB 집계.
• 스크린샷 파일 경로 목록(~/.dev-browser/tmp/…).
• 이상 징후(콘솔 에러, 4xx/5xx, 누락 이벤트)와 추측(표시). 수정 제안은 하되 코드는 고치지 않는다.

Dev Browser is a CLI for controlling local or external browsers with JavaScript scripts.
Scripts run in a sandboxed QuickJS runtime (not Node.js). Top-level `await` is
available, along with a preconnected `browser` global and standard `console` output.
A background daemon starts automatically when needed and manages browser instances,
named pages, and CDP connections.

SANDBOX ENVIRONMENT:
  Scripts execute inside a QuickJS WASM sandbox with no arbitrary access to the host system.
  This is NOT Node.js — the following are NOT available:
    - require() / import()     No module loading
    - process                  No process access
    - fs / path / os           No direct filesystem access
    - fetch / WebSocket        No direct network access
    - __dirname / __filename   No path globals

  Available globals:
    browser                    Pre-connected browser handle (see API below)
    console                    log, warn, error, info (routed to CLI output)
    setTimeout / clearTimeout  Basic timers
    saveScreenshot(buf, name)  Save a screenshot buffer (async, must be awaited)
    writeFile(name, data)      Write a file to temp dir (async, must be awaited)
    readFile(name)             Read a file from temp dir (async, must be awaited)

  Memory and CPU limits are enforced. Infinite loops will be interrupted.

Primary invocation styles:
  dev-browser <<'EOF'
    const page = await browser.getPage("main");
    await page.goto("https://example.com");
    console.log(await page.title());
  EOF

  dev-browser run script.js
  dev-browser --browser my-project < script.js
  dev-browser --connect http://localhost:9222 <<'EOF'
    const page = await browser.getPage("main");
    await page.goto("https://example.com");
  EOF
  dev-browser --connect <<'EOF'
    const page = await browser.getPage("main");

=== SectionView impl ===
"use client";

/**
 * Wraps a section of a (server) page and emits section.viewed once per page
 * view, when ≥25% of the section or ≥200px of it has scrolled into view.
 * A pathname change re-arms it. No-op where IntersectionObserver is missing.
 */

import { useEffect, useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { isSectionReached } from "@/lib/ui-telemetry/client-pure";
import { trackUi } from "./track";

export default function SectionView({ section, children }: { section: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") return;
    let sent = false;
    // 0.05 steps cover the 25% rule; the extra 200px/height point makes the
    // observer fire exactly where the 200px rule turns true on tall sections
    // (with 0/0.25 alone, nothing fires between 0 and 25% of an 800px+ box).
    const height = el.getBoundingClientRect().height;
    const steps = Array.from({ length: 21 }, (_, i) => i / 20);
    if (height > 0) steps.push(Math.min(1, 200 / height));
    const threshold = Array.from(new Set(steps)).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        for (const entry of entries) {
          if (sent) return;
          if (!isSectionReached(entry.intersectionRect.height, entry.boundingClientRect.height)) continue;
          sent = true;
          trackUi("section.viewed", { section });
          observer.disconnect();
          return;
        }
      },
      { threshold },
    );
    observer.observe(el);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [pathname, section]);

  return (
    <div ref={ref} data-section={section} className="empty:hidden">
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

=== client.ts ===
// Browser side of UI telemetry: session cookie upkeep + the single
// fire-and-forget POST to /api/telemetry. Pure shaping lives in
// lib/ui-telemetry/client-pure (node-testable); this file owns the DOM.

import { SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, isSessionId } from "@/lib/ui-telemetry/session-cookie";
import {
  buildUiEventBody,
  isAdminPath,
  readCookie,
  sessionCookieString,
  uuidV4FromBytes,
  viewportClass,
  type UiEventProps,
} from "@/lib/ui-telemetry/client-pure";

function newSessionId(): string {
  // crypto.randomUUID only exists in secure contexts (https / localhost);
  // a LAN-IP dev origin falls back to getRandomValues-based v4.
  return crypto.randomUUID?.() ?? uuidV4FromBytes(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16)));
}

/**
 * Reads ak_sid, minting a fresh UUID v4 when missing/invalid, and always
 * rewrites the cookie so Max-Age slides another 30 minutes from now.
 */
export function ensureSessionCookie(): void {
  try {
    const existing = readCookie(document.cookie, SESSION_COOKIE_NAME);
    const id = isSessionId(existing) ? existing : newSessionId();
    document.cookie = sessionCookieString(id, location.protocol === "https:");
  } catch {
    // telemetry must never block the UI (cookie access can throw in sandboxed
    // iframes / cookie-blocked contexts)
  }
}

/** app/layout.tsx renders <html lang={locale}> from next-intl — read it back. */
export function getLocale(): string | undefined {
  return document.documentElement.lang || undefined;
}

/** No-op during SSR and on /admin routes; never throws, never awaits. */
export function sendUiEvent(event: string, props?: UiEventProps): void {
  try {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
    const path = window.location.pathname;
    if (isAdminPath(path)) return;
    ensureSessionCookie();
    const body = buildUiEventBody(event, path, {
      ...props,
      locale: getLocale(),
      viewport: viewportClass(window.innerWidth),
    });
    // Fire-and-forget capture signal — must never block the UI.
    fetch("/api/telemetry", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
      keepalive: true,
    }).catch(() => {});
  } catch {
    // telemetry must never block the UI — this runs synchronously at the top
    // of CTA handlers, so a throw here would abort the user's action
  }
}

=== track.ts ===
// Public entry point for client UI telemetry. Import this from client
// components; path comes from window.location, session cookie is refreshed,
// /admin routes and SSR are no-ops (see ./client).

import { sendUiEvent } from "./client";

export type ClientUiEvent = "page.viewed" | "tab.viewed" | "section.viewed" | "cta.clicked" | "nav.clicked";

export function trackUi(event: ClientUiEvent, props?: Record<string, string | number | boolean>): void {
  sendUiEvent(event, props);
}

=== useTabViewed ===
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { trackUi } from "./track";

/**
 * Emits tab.viewed for the active tab: trigger "default" for the tab shown on
 * mount, "click" for every change after. The ref also dedupes StrictMode's
 * double effect so the mount tab is not reported twice.
 */
export function useTabViewed(tab: string): void {
  const lastTab = useRef<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (tab === lastTab.current) return;
    const trigger = lastTab.current === null ? "default" : "click";
    lastTab.current = tab;
    trackUi("tab.viewed", { tab, trigger });
  }, [tab]);
}

=== route.ts ===
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { requireAuth } from "@/lib/auth";
import { apiHandler } from "@/lib/api-handler";
import { checkRateLimit } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { Telemetry } from "@/lib/telemetry";
import { SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, isSessionId } from "@/lib/ui-telemetry/session-cookie";
import { extractProjectId, normalizePagePath } from "@/lib/ui-telemetry/page-route";

/** Events the client capture may report. Everything else is emitted server-side. */
const CLIENT_UI_EVENTS = ["page.viewed", "tab.viewed", "section.viewed", "cta.clicked", "nav.clicked"];

const MAX_PATH_LENGTH = 512;
const MAX_PROP_KEYS = 20;
const MAX_STRING_VALUE_LENGTH = 200;

type UiEventProps = Record<string, string | number | boolean>;

/**
 * Flat object, ≤20 keys, values string(≤200 chars) | finite number | boolean.
 * The client already shapes props this way (lib/ui-telemetry/client-pure), so
 * anything else is misuse and gets a 400 rather than silently dropped keys.
 */
function isFlatProps(value: unknown): value is UiEventProps {
  if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) return false;
  const entries = Object.entries(value);
  if (entries.length > MAX_PROP_KEYS) return false;
  return entries.every(([, v]) =>
    (typeof v === "string" && v.length <= MAX_STRING_VALUE_LENGTH) ||
    (typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v)) ||
    typeof v === "boolean",
  );
}

export const POST = apiHandler(async (request: NextRequest) => {
  const session = await requireAuth();

  // Generous limit — a page view plus a handful of section/cta events per navigation
  const rl = checkRateLimit(`ui-telemetry:${session.userId}`, { limit: 300, windowSec: 600 });
  if (!rl.allowed) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Too many requests" },
      { status: 429, headers: { "Retry-After": String(Math.ceil((rl.resetAt - Date.now()) / 1000)) } }
    );
  }

  let body: unknown;
  try {
    body = await request.json();
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid JSON body" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  const { event, path, props } = (body ?? {}) as { event?: unknown; path?: unknown; props?: unknown };

  if (typeof event !== "string" || !CLIENT_UI_EVENTS.includes(event)) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `event must be one of: ${CLIENT_UI_EVENTS.join(", ")}` },
      { status: 400 },
    );
  }
  if (typeof path !== "string" || !path.startsWith("/") || path.length > MAX_PATH_LENGTH) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `path must start with "/" and be at most ${MAX_PATH_LENGTH} chars` },
      { status: 400 },
    );
  }
  if (props !== undefined && !isFlatProps(props)) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `props must be a flat object of string | number | boolean values (≤${MAX_PROP_KEYS} keys, strings ≤${MAX_STRING_VALUE_LENGTH} chars)` },
      { status: 400 },
    );
  }

  // Server-owned attribution: the client never sends these, and if it tries,
  // the server values win.
  const rawSessionId = request.cookies.get(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME)?.value;
  const sessionId = isSessionId(rawSessionId) ? rawSessionId : undefined;
  const routeTemplate = normalizePagePath(path);
  const projectId = extractProjectId(path);

  // Fire-and-forget: track() never throws, and the writer swallows sink failures.
  Telemetry.uiEvent(
    event,
    { userId: session.userId, sessionId, projectId },
    { ...props, path, routeTemplate, tier: session.tier },
  );

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
});

• 크레딧 5 차감. 잔액 650. Gemini 토큰 약 2만 개 소모.
• 해당 채널의 inspiration 추천 3행이 재생성돼 이전 추천이 덮였습니다. 미리보기 렌더는 발생하지 않았고 30크레딧 과금도 없습니다.
• telemetry에 cta.clicked: deep-scan 1행이 남아 usage 탭 CTA 표에 보입니다.

제가 프롬프트에 크레딧 소모 버튼 금지 규칙을 넣었지만 선택자 실수를 막지는 못했습니다. 후속 조치는 사용자 결정 사항입니다. 크레딧 5 보정은 admin 지급으로 가능하고, 덮인 추천 3행은 복구 수단이 없습니다. 원하시면 보정 여부를 알려 주세요.

0번 기록에 재발 방지 규칙을 추가하겠습니다. 브라우저 검증에서 클릭 대상은 접근 가능한 이름이나 data 속성으로만 고르고, 클릭 전에 버튼 텍스트에 "credit"이 있으면 건너뛰는 가드를 스크립트에 넣는다는 내용입니다. 나머지 흐름은 완료됐고 DB 대조가 진행 중이라 최종 보고를 기다립니다.

=== UiTelemetryRoot (page.viewed trigger) ===
"use client";

/**
 * Mounted once in the protected layout: emits page.viewed on every
 * usePathname() change. The ref dedupes StrictMode's double effect and the
 * same-path re-render case, and doubles as the SPA referrer for the next view.
 */

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { referrerPath } from "@/lib/ui-telemetry/client-pure";
import { trackUi } from "./track";

export default function UiTelemetryRoot() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const lastPath = useRef<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pathname || pathname === lastPath.current) return;
    // First load: fall back to a same-origin document.referrer path (if any).
    const from = lastPath.current ?? referrerPath(document.referrer, window.location.origin);
    lastPath.current = pathname;
    trackUi("page.viewed", from ? { referrerPath: from } : {});
  }, [pathname]);

  return null;
}
